simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אָמוֹן (H525) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אָמוֹן (ʼâmôwn) means skilled , i.e. an architect First listed occurrence: Prov 8 30.

definitions.full: H525. amon II. אָמוֺן noun masculine artificer, architect, master-workman , as firm and sure in his workman-ship: אָמוֺן אֶצְלוֺ וָאֶהְיֶה I was at his side architect , master-workman ( ᵑ9 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Ges Ew De MV RV, > foster-son AE Ki AV) Prov 8:30 ; הָֽאָמוֺן יֶתֶר rest of the master-workmen Jer 52:15 (Hi Gf De RVm, but rest of the multitude Ges MV RV et al., אמון = המון ) — I. אָמוֺן see above.
definitions.rootNote: from 539 , probably in the sense of training; like 542
